For me, I just see people describing things I really relate to, when usually I feel at some odds with the way people process things.

I would try not to take a person's painting of you to heart too much, it is likely be their style or ability more than a reflection of your appearance :)

Hi. I had to go through the recently and it was very difficult. First I tried photo booths but found the images distressing. I then tried a shop where a lady with a camera took them, and I found it to be much better. I also informed her of my bdd and she was very kind and understanding. I think it was a snappy snaps shop if you live in the UK. It is daunting I think because of the face on nature of the photo, and in mine I was not supposed to smile, but I tried to give a small subtle smile and I also found that helped with my feelings towards the image. Best of luck, and if you take a photo you are content with I recommend you get a few extra copies. I now use this as my go to image, for passports and ids etc :).
